To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) AR outperforms CI and M on brand evaluation and interactive response; 2) CI outperforms AR and M on usability; 3) AR outperformed M on brand recommendation and 4) the effect of interface systems on psychological variables is mediated by brand familiarity and perceived risk, and moderated by opinion leadership and positive affective traits.
AR outperforms the conventional interface in the emotional response and interactive response.

(1) the use of AR and M is superior to CI in the emotional and interactive responses, but not in usability and intention to buy, (2) the use of a simple interface (CI) is superior to a sophisticated one (AR and M) in usability and intention, but not in emotional and interactive responses and brand recommendation and (3) the use of sophisticated interfaces (M and AR) is superior to CI and M in brand recommendation.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how the interface influences the online shopping experience and the effect of those interface systems on the consumer behavior.
the effect of the three different interfaces (CI, M and AR) on consumer response in online shopping.
the impact that the interface system used in online shopping has on consumer response, brand evaluation and intention to buy the product.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the superiority of AR over CI is mediated by the interaction between the consumer's brand familiarity and perceived risk.
AR and M interfaces outperform CI interface in terms of brand attitude, brand recommendation, interactive response and emotional response.
AR is superior to M and CI, but only when the brand is not very familiar to the consumer.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the effect of those three interfaces is mediated by brand familiarity and perceived risk.
AR is not necessarily superior to other interfaces, but it is a very powerful tool that can be used to enhance the brand evaluation, brand recommendation and the emotional response.

the effect of interface system on the consumer's decision process is mediated by psychological factors, and the effect on the consumer's attitude is mediated by the consumer's perception of the interface.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the effect of the three interfaces is not uniform across the variables.
the use of AR and M is a good strategy to improve brand recommendation and brand attitude, but not to improve the intention to buy.
a sophisticated interface is not always a good interface.
